fact: At the launch of the National Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Policy and its Implementation Plan, the UN Resident Coordinator credits the Government with developing the 2021-25 Civil Registration and Vital Statistics National Strategic Action Plan, says the policy complements the recently launched INRIS, and says the UN System, with financial support from the Government of Japan, procured biometric kits for all 116 districts and 25 health facilities; the fetched text carries no date, so the page's publication date as returned by the search is used.
title: Launch of the National Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Policy
